items.title: Frank Christian Interview, 1965-09-06
items.q: So, actually, probably when you played with Baquet, it was with Papa Lane's band. Yeah. More than like that. Lane used to get in. Yeah.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Yeah, I wanted to tell you about that the other day. I thought about him. I said, Rick Roland, he... Leo Grillo, he was a... He was a man. He... I think he played with Gallagher some. He played with me, but he wouldn't play with everybody. He was kind of a funny... Funny... Funny sort of a fella. He was an old man and he... He was particular, in other words, who he played with. He was a good clarinet player. But, uh... I don't know, he...
He was a good clarinet player. So, actually, probably when you played with Baquet, it was with Papa Lane's band. Yeah.
More than like that. Lane used to get in. Yeah.
